services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Our interactive field trips bring the city to life through dynamic exhibitions, hands-on activities, and enduring questions that inspire curiosity and connection. Join us as we explore the places where art, innovation, and change are created and debated; the ideas that can only emerge from the unique character of New York City; and the people who shaped and dared to reimagine their city. services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: The Museum of the City of New York's beautifully renovated landmark building on Fifth Avenue's iconic Museum Mile is the perfect venue for weddings, bar/bat mitzvahs, corporate events, fundraisers, holiday parties, and more. Listed as a top wedding venue in NYC, our award-winning Museum has been featured in the Knot, New York magazine, Carats and Cake, Style Me Pretty, and much more! The Ronay Menschel Hall is a newly renovated, flexible function room. This fully equipped facility features an ample stage, a green room, and cutting-edge AV booth.
